name: Bell Partners (Bell Apartment Living)
notes: Researched from public bellpartnersinc.com pages (Support Services, Contact). The site header's Resident Login links to the RentCafe portal bellpartnersinc.securecafe.com (the footer link uses bellapartmentliving.securecafe.com). Contact: Resident Customer Service - choose your community from the list for its dedicated phone and email (no national resident line); HQ 300 N. Greene Street, Suite 1000, Greensboro, NC 27401, 336.232.1900 (listed on Contact for Greensboro HQ - reviewer, used as the contact phone). Portfolio about 65,000 apartments. Note: bellapartmentliving.com (no subdomain) is NOT Bell's site (unrelated listing site) - not used. Fees, autopay, notice periods and sign-in fields not published (family defaults kept, inferred). FIX 2026-10-10 (housing audit fixer): contact-us help now says community phone numbers are not listed in the resident portal (the mock has no community picker; open cross-owner request) instead of pointing at a chooser on this site; pay-your-bill article retitled from Resident Login to Paying rent: Resident Login so the help index link matches its target.

help.title: Resident customer service
paragraphs: Bell Partners has no single resident phone line: each community has its own customer service phone number and email. They are not listed in the resident portal; on the Bell Partners public website, open Contact and choose your community from the list under Resident Customer Service to see them, or send a message with the Resident Services form. Bell Partners headquarters is at 300 N. Greene Street, Suite 1000, Greensboro, NC 27401 (336.232.1900).

help.title: Paying rent: Resident Login
paragraphs: Use Resident Login at the top of the Bell Partners site to reach the resident portal.

extra.intent: Using the Bell Partners help pages, find out how to get your community's customer service phone number. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: Each community has its own phone number: on the Bell Partners website Contact page, choose your community under Resident Customer Service to see its phone number and email.
